patch_description: Add several geometry-aware restart families rather than relying mostly on perturbations of the same square grid.  The original 5-by-5 grid plus an interstitial circle is retained, since it provides good boundary coverage, but alternate seeds receive a small staggered-row displacement and a vertical compression/expansion.  These are controlled deformations toward triangular/hexagonal contact graphs while preserving a sensible initial LP solution.  Additional deterministic seeds explore different interstices and boundary asymmetries; this is inexpensive relative to the 360-second limit and avoids the zero-probability requirement that one jitter land near the best asymmetric contact graph.
